title: Flying to Tanzania From the Netherlands and Belgium
excerpt: Flying to Tanzania from the Netherlands or Belgium: direct options, transfers and tips for a smooth journey.
body:
Many of our travellers come from the Netherlands and Belgium. Good news: Tanzania is easy to reach.

## From Amsterdam

KLM has operated direct flights from Amsterdam to Kilimanjaro, sometimes continuing to Dar es Salaam. Schedules change, so check current options.

## With a stopover

Airlines such as Qatar Airways, Emirates, Turkish Airlines, Ethiopian Airlines and Kenya Airways connect via their hubs to Kilimanjaro, Dar es Salaam or Zanzibar.

## From Brussels

From Brussels, connections usually go via a hub. Some travellers drive or take the train to Amsterdam for a direct flight.

## Flight time

A direct flight takes about eight to nine hours. With a stopover, plan on 12 to 18 hours in total.

## Time difference

Tanzania is two hours ahead of the Netherlands in winter and one hour in summer. Jet lag is minimal.

## Tip

Arrive at Kilimanjaro and leave from Zanzibar for an efficient route. See [flights to Tanzania](/blog/flights-to-tanzania/).
